name: Williamsville Place
summary: Williamsville Place is a community-focused open-air shopping center on Sheridan Drive in Williamsville, NY, managed by DLC Management Corp. With strong customer ratings and convenient daily hours, it serves as a popular retail destination for this affluent Buffalo suburb.
demographics: Williamsville Place serves the affluent Buffalo suburb of Williamsville, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area draws from established residential neighborhoods with a mix of young families, empty nesters, and working professionals aged 35-65. Shoppers in this market tend to value convenience and quality, seeking everyday necessities alongside specialty retail in a well-maintained open-air environment that serves the daily needs of this prosperous Western New York community.
description: Williamsville Place is a well-established open-air shopping center located at 5395 Sheridan Drive in the heart of Williamsville, New York, one of Buffalo's most desirable suburban communities. Managed by DLC Management Corp, a respected commercial real estate firm specializing in open-air value shopping centers, this property exemplifies their commitment to creating vibrant retail destinations that serve local communities. The center benefits from DLC Management's comprehensive approach to property management, which includes expert leasing, development capabilities, and third-party real estate services that ensure the property remains competitive and well-maintained. With convenient hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Williamsville Place provides accessible shopping for the surrounding residential neighborhoods and serves as a community gathering place. The center's strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 500 Google reviews reflects its popularity among local shoppers who appreciate its convenient location along the busy Sheridan Drive corridor and its mix of retail and service tenants that cater to everyday needs.
